description.value: Nature's Fare Markets is a BC-based natural and organic grocery chain; the Langley location opened in 2010 as the brand's first lower mainland store. The shop carries certified organic produce, ethically sourced meats and dairy, vitamins, and clean beauty products, all held to strict ingredient standards with over 500 banned additives. An in-store Bistro rounds out the stop with smoothies, made-to-order sandwiches, grab-and-go salads, and specialty espresso drinks.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content for the Langley store page is fully available and confirms the address, phone, and core offerings. The store lists organic produce, grab-and-go foods, a bistro with smoothies and made-to-order sandwiches, and specialty drinks, confirming basic groceries and hot food. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the website or in OSM tags; those fields remain null. A minor discrepancy exists between OSM's unit '5-120' and the website's '120 –' for the unit number.
concerns: Unit number discrepancy: OSM tags list addr:unit as '5-120' but the website lists the unit as '120 –' (i.e., '120 – 19880 Langley Bypass'). May be the same unit described differently; worth verifying on-site.
No bike parking or bike rack information found on website or in OSM tags — key WWC required criterion is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, well-stocked natural grocery with an in-store bistro offering hot and grab-and-go food; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists in Langley.
